title: Inspector resource texture stale when resource is changed
body:
### Tested versions

Found in Godot 4.6 and 4.7. Some related bugs ([here](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/33745) and [here](https://github.com/viniciusgerevini/godot-aseprite-wizard/issues/231)) indicate this might be a longstanding issue.

### System information

Godot v4.6.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6626) - AMD Ryzen 9 7945HX with Radeon Graphics (32 threads) - 31.18 GiB memory

### Issue description

In a project I'm working on, I have a custom resource which contains a Texture2D. When replacing one of the textures on disk and allowing Godot to reimport it, the preview thumbnail shown in the EditorResourcePicker continued displaying the old image. The only way to have the preview reflect the new image was to close the scene and reopen.

### Steps to reproduce

1) Open the MRP
2) Click the "hex" node, open the terrain database resource
3) Open the 1st entry in the resource (should be "rock" type)
4) Click the preview icon to ensure the larger image shows
5) In file explorer or finder, perform the following actions in order:
- a) delete `rock.png` and `rock.png.import` from the `assets/tiles/` folder
- b) copy either `rock1.png` or `rock2.png` (whichever is different from the one currently being used) from `assets/other_tiles`
- c) paste the file in `assets/tiles/`
- d) rename the pasted file `rock.png`
- e) return to godot

See the following video using the MRP:
https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/590afd0b-1821-408f-ba65-50f8f8523e4f
